haus.kicker: The read · what Haus's tests mean for you
haus.title: Count the lag, cap the catalog, and trust Meta's newer setting more than its older ones
haus.dek: Six findings from Haus's holdout tests that change how a DTC buyer on Meta and Google should run and judge BFCM. Every figure is from Haus's own reports and posts.

points.h: Don't judge BFCM on day-of numbers
points.p: In Haus's Cyber Week 2025 tests, counting the lift that arrived after ads stopped turned a $1 iROAS into $1.75. For tests starting before BFCM, 41% of the value came after the ads ended, and fashion and apparel saw a 93% average latent gain. Read BFCM results two to three weeks later, not on Cyber Monday.

points.h: Catalog ads lose their edge in Q4
points.p: Meta catalog-led tests starting October to December returned 0.64x of the same brand's other Meta ads, against 1.07x from January to September. Accounts with light catalog use (2 to 20% of Meta) did best at 1.45x. Cap catalog share for the sale and check the ad-level Product Browsing setting Northbeam flags.

points.h: Meta's Incremental Attribution now beats standard
points.p: Haus's October read puts IA at 1.18x the incremental return of standard attribution since mid-2025, and 1.26x for DTC-only brands, a reversal from 0.80x the year before. IA also tracks holdout results best of Meta's settings (0.79 rank correlation, against 0.40 for 1-day view).

points.h: YouTube is worth more than Google Ads says
points.p: Geo tests found 2.3x the DTC sales Google Ads reported for YouTube, with 24% of the lift arriving after ads stopped and 75 cents of off-site sales for every DTC dollar. Judge YouTube on blended revenue and halo, not in-platform ROAS.

points.h: In non-brand search, Shopping has overtaken text
points.p: Indexed against each brand's other media, non-brand Shopping returned 1.19 in the second half of 2025 against 0.62 for text, and 0.99 against 0.75 in the first half of 2026. If budget is tight before the sale, protect Shopping over non-brand text.

points.h: Benchmarks won't settle it: test your own account
points.p: Haus says part of the IA reversal reflects which brands tested recently. Its film and streaming study found the same channel 4.4x dearer for one streamer than expected, and Shopify paused US spend in some channels to measure incrementality. Plan a geo holdout for January.
